messages:
Sam: Dropped a new prototype for CSV export + audit sidecar: https://figma.com/file/export-audit
Ari: Scanned it. Biggest gap: exported CSV currently omits role inheritance info. We need an inherited_from column for post-hoc audits
Nia: Agreed. Also include changed_by and change_reason columns so security can map CSV rows back to audit entries
Omar: Accessibility first pass: export modal must set aria-modal=true, trap focus, and move focus to the modal title on open
Becca: On CSV import/invite: invalid rows should be marked inline and not block the whole upload. Show errors per row with suggestions
Sam: Proposed flow: upload -> parse -> preview pane lists valid rows and inline errors, with a toggle to skip invalid rows or download an errors CSV
Ari: Microcopy: 'Skip invalid rows' feels cryptic. Suggest 'Skip invalid recipients' or 'Process valid rows only' for clarity
Nia: For screen reader users announce a summary after parsing using aria-live, e.g., 'Upload complete: 12 processed, 3 failed'
Omar: Visual nit: export CTA label currently just 'Export'. Use 'Export roles CSV' and add a schema dropdown: Full / Minimal export
Becca: When opening audit sidecar from a CSV row, deep-link to the matching audit entry and highlight it briefly so users can correlate changes
Sam: Keyboard nav: in the sidecar Tab should move through filters, row list, and back to the close button. Arrow keys for row navigation would be nice
Ari: Contrast: the CSV template link is low contrast at 2.9:1. Either darken it or add an underline. Needs to meet 4.5:1 for body text
Nia: Invite copy inconsistency again: 'Send invite' vs 'Send invitations'. I recommend 'Send invitations' for the primary action and dynamic copy in confirmations
Omar: Security requirement: redact sensitive columns in exports unless the user has explicit export permission. Show a modal warning with 'I understand' checkbox
Becca: Audit deep-link actions should include a 'Copy link' that encodes the current filters and selector state so support can reproduce issues
Sam: Dev note: make exports job-based. Return a job id on upload, poll status, show progress, allow cancel, and persist in activity stream
Ari: UX: include an example CSV row inline in the modal to reduce parsing errors. Example: role,email,inherited_from
Nia: A11y detail: each inline correction input needs an aria-label like 'Row 5 email correction' and the error summary should be focusable
Omar: Drag and drop area needs accessible name and instructions. When focused, announce 'Drop files to upload or press Enter to browse'
Becca: QA: I'll schedule keyboard + NVDA pass once modal hits staging. Will test large files and batch invite edge cases
QA-bot: Logged UX-1427: csv export accessibility, audit sidecar deep-linking, and redact modal
Sam: Thanks team. Action items: Ari will add inherited_from column and example row, Omar will spec focus trap and SR announcements, Becca will document redaction modal and preview UX, Nia will draft error copy and SR labels, QA-bot will track the ticket.
